user_instruction: Build a single-file three.js scene of a tiny potted cactus. A tiny potted cactus: a small terracotta pot (kept as a separate part) containing packed soil, from which rises a rounded ribbed globular cactus body with small spine clusters. Clean, readable object; desk-plant scale. Make it procedural from three.js geometry with realistic proportions, materials and lighting, and orbit controls.
